problem: Write a Python function named add_two_numbers(a, b) that returns the arithmetic sum of a and b. Do not print anything.
Write a Python function named is_palindrome(s) that returns True exactly when s reads the same forwards and backwards. Treat the input case-sensitively and do not ignore spaces.
Write a Python function named count_vowels(s) that returns the number of English vowels in s. Count both lowercase and uppercase a, e, i, o, u.
Write a Python function named max_subarray(nums) that returns the maximum sum of any non-empty contiguous subarray of nums.

Write a Python function named two_sum(nums, target) that returns a pair [i, j] of distinct indices whose values sum to target. Return the first valid pair found when scanning i from left to right and j from i+1 to right. Inputs contain exactly one valid pair.
